flags.title: Stone and Strand `SS-MIA` / `SS-RITA`: Karat Conflict and Final-Sale Findings
flags.detail: The canonical dated evidence records a 14K specification versus 10K image-alt conflict for SS-MIA and final-sale/non-returnable wording for the linked rows. Raw price displays remain unassigned where ISO currency or configuration support is absent. These rows fail the walk-away rule unless the exact order has a qualifying return after independent verification.
flags.action: Do not purchase final-sale jewelry without qualifying return rights; require written karat and configuration clarification and preserve the official evidence.

flags.title: Factory Direct Jewelry `FDJ-GR0001`: Weight Scope, Stone Mass, and Reputation Evidence Require Review
flags.detail: The canonical evidence records a displayed item weight alongside diamond carat weight without confirming a stone-free metal weight. The companion therefore leaves metal-only weight blank and does not subtract stones to create a product fact. Seller solid-gold wording, a stamp, and review/complaint allegations are not independent purity or durability findings; consult the canonical retailer record for current dated metrics and policy terms rather than duplicating them here.
flags.action: Do not treat solid-gold wording, a stamp, or complaints as proof of durability or purity. Resolve the ambiguous weight and obtain an independent inspection.

flags.title: Missing Metal Weight in Grams on Mainstream Settings (`Blue Nile`, `Brilliant Earth`, `Mejuri`, `Zales`, `Stone & Strand`, `Menē` PDP)
flags.detail: Most mass-market engagement ring PDPs omit gram weight entirely (`weight_g: null`). Under the No-Hallucinations Policy, missing weights are never estimated from band width.
flags.action: Request size-specific metal gram weight in writing from customer support before checkout, then verify on an independent jeweler's calibrated scale upon arrival.

flags.title: Sarraf Jewelry Inc. (`SAR-*`): Internal Policy Contradictions & Size-10 Weight Benchmark Variance
flags.detail: The canonical dated Sarraf evidence records policy-wording differences, size-specific weight questions, and buyer-review statements. Review statements are not independent measurements of the selected order, and seller weights are not calibrated-scale results. Consult the linked official product, policy, and reputation evidence for the exact dated wording; this flag does not duplicate mutable amounts or metrics.
flags.action: Confirm exact gram weight for your ring size in writing before ordering, avoid engraving before XRF/scale inspection, and pay by credit card.

flags.title: Gross Item Weight vs Stone-Free Metal Weight (`AG-SAPPHIRE-RING`, `AV-BRIDGE`, `AV-CLEAN`)
flags.detail: The canonical evidence distinguishes seller-reported metal weight from gross gemstone-ring item weight and selected-size ranges. The companion uses only a supported single metal weight in calculations; gross displays and ranges remain explanatory text, never an inferred product fine-gold mass.
flags.action: Use the gemstone carat deduction input (`1 ct = 0.200 g`) in the calculator when weighing set rings; never plug gross stone+metal mass directly into pure alloy melt.

flags.title: Zales Currency and Price-Label Render Instability
flags.detail: Dated captures across the four canonical Zales rows alternate between labeled and unlabeled displays. The companion preserves raw displays only as unassigned text and leaves structured price/currency blank because the captured pages do not establish an ISO currency. It does not choose current/original roles from amount position.
flags.action: Keep every Zales amount unassigned until the exact selected configuration, price role, and native currency are confirmed on the official page and at checkout.

flags.title: Zero Physical XRF or Calibrated Scale Assays Performed Remotely
flags.detail: The registers contain dated web observations with different re-read coverage. No physical ring, stamp, purity, or scale measurement was independently examined. Seller text and stamps can differ from the delivered piece.
flags.action: Upon arrival — before wearing, resizing, or removing tags — ask an independent jeweler to weigh the ring and select an appropriate purity assessment, potentially including XRF and additional tests where surface readings are insufficient.

flags.title: BN-316238 Product-Identity Mismatch; Former Companion Price Removed
flags.detail: The canonical 2026-10-23 review records that this URL served 'Comfort Fit Solitaire Engagement Ring In 14K White Gold By James Allen', stock 505097w14, rather than the stored Petite Micropavé record. An earlier companion row nevertheless assigned $1,240 USD to BN-316238. The companion now follows the canonical blank price and does not attach the served amount to the stored item. This is a documentation correction, not a claim about a current offer.
flags.action: Do not use the stored row for a purchase decision. Reopen the official URL, resolve the product identity and configuration, and review canonical F-041/F-042 before considering any amount.

flags.title: Unconfirmed Seller Fields Stay Blank
flags.detail: The companion seller table is generated from canonical records and leaves unsupported return windows, payment methods, contact details, and independent-reputation fields blank. In particular, the combined Menē record does not establish a return window; an earlier companion value is not repeated. Blank is an evidence gap, not a negative finding about a seller.
flags.action: Obtain the exact order's return, payment, contact, and independent-inspection terms in writing. Review the linked canonical evidence and do not treat a generic policy or review profile as order-specific permission.

flags.title: Explicit Solid-Gold Wording Is Not Confirmed
flags.detail: Karat alone does not meet this project's qualifying-ring rule. A row with blank or false explicit-solid-gold status is not represented as qualifying, even when a nominal karat calculation is possible. Plated, vermeil, filled, overlay, and gold-tone items do not qualify.
flags.action: Require explicit solid-gold wording for the exact product and configuration, then independently verify the delivered piece; do not infer solid gold from a karat stamp.

flags.title: Configuration-Specific ISO-USD Price Is Unassigned
flags.detail: The structured price is blank because the canonical record does not support an assigned positive USD amount for the exact item/configuration. A raw dollar display may be retained only as unassigned text; it is not converted into a current price by position, guesswork, or formatting.
flags.action: Reopen the official listing, select the exact configuration, confirm native currency and price scope, and save dated evidence before using any amount in a purchase comparison.
